item.title: Predicting Mild Cognitive Impairment Progression via Multi-Modal EHR Data
item.description:
Overview We developed a novel machine learning pipeline leveraging electronic health records to identify early biomarkers of Alzheimer’s disease.

Problem Motivation Current diagnostic criteria rely on late-stage symptomatic observation. There is a need for pre-symptomatic detection using universally available clinical data.

Methodology Our approach integrates longitudinal patient data with ensemble methods, predicting future cognitive decline.

Key Findings Achieved state-of-the-art sensitivity in pre-symptomatic detection across a cohort of 15,000+ patients.

item.title: Longitudinal Trajectories of Amyloid-Beta and Cognitive Decline in Aging Populations
item.description:
Overview A comprehensive survival analysis investigating the long-term impact of Amyloid-Beta accumulation on cognitive function.

Problem Motivation The precise temporal relationship between biomarker accumulation and clinical decline remains highly variable and poorly understood at an individualized level.

Methodology Utilized deep survival models and landmark analysis to map individualized risk trajectories.

Key Findings Demonstrated that specific baseline biomarker thresholding can predict severe decline 5-7 years prior to clinical symptoms.
